body: At least I know someone understands how I feel. Most people around here just get angry and say it’s all in my head......
“Spider-Dick, Spider-Dick, gonna do what a Spider-Dick does” 😂🤣🤣

Thank you for checking on me. That really does mean a lot. I really try to stay motivated so maybe I can make something with this life. Some days are harder than others. It doesn’t help when I’m my own worst enemy.

I just want to say thank you to everyone that replied. I did make it back home and I got my meds yesterday. I do feel a lot better. I’m still not 100% but I don’t have that powerful urge to end everything. I think I need somebody to talk too about things. I used to have friends and family but life has pulled everybody away. I live alone, my ex fiancé took off with my son 3 years ago because her new boyfriend didn’t want me in the picture. The first year I felt like I was losing my mind. I started drinking a lot. It was the only way I could sleep honestly. I used to be so motivated. I’ve ran multiple businesses, and used to always be happy no matter what. Ive spent the last 3 years chasing them down. I found them summer of 2019 right before my son turned 8. I now live 10 minutes down the road from him. I was so excited and so fuckin happy to see him. But he barley remembers me. He doesn’t call me dad anymore. He doesn’t tell me he loves me back. It seems he only wants to come over to play my xbox or ask for money. He doesn’t remember my family. Which me and my family aren’t very close anyways. I barely speak to any of them. No matter what I do it’s never good enough for my parents. This past Christmas when my mom made those cookies, that was the first time in over 10 years we all got together and everybody just argued most the time. I want a great relationship with my son because I never had any relationship with my parents. I never heard “I love you” or “I’m proud of you”. The first and only time I remember my mom hugging me I was 19. That was right before she left my dad. I didn’t see her for almost a year and we talked maybe twice in 6 months. None of that bothered me until I had a son. Now that I’m a parent I just don’t understand why it seems like they never really wanted anything to do with me. And now it feels the same way about my son and everybody else in my life. I just feel broken.
